title: Trifla Guggul
description: Trifla Guggul (Triphala Guggul) blends the detoxification properties of Triphala (three fruits) with Guggul resin for comprehensive colon and hemorrhoid management. This classical formulation shrinks anal piles mass through anti-inflammatory action and improved circulation. Heals fistulas (abnormal connections between tissue surfaces) through tissue repair and infection control. Cleanses the colon of accumulated waste and toxins that contribute to disease. Aids in weight reduction through improved bowel function and toxin elimination. This formulation provides multiple benefits for digestive and eliminative health.
